title: Open-Meteo historical archive – Sydney 33.8688S 151.2093E, 23–31 August 2026
claims: The query returns nine daily records for 23–31 August 2026 at a Sydney grid point returned as 33.848858S, 151.19551E with an elevation of 86 metres.
Daily maximum temperature across the nine days ranges from 16.7°C to 20.5°C, with a median of 18.6°C.
Daily minimum temperature across the nine days ranges from 8.7°C to 14.1°C, with a median of 10.7°C.
Four of the nine days record at least 1 mm of precipitation and two of the nine record at least 5 mm.
On race day, 30 August 2026, the grid point records a maximum of 19.1°C, a minimum of 8.9°C and 0.0 mm of precipitation.
The values are modelled historical data for a grid point, not measurements on the course, and are not a forecast.
